question: In quadrilateral \(ABCD\), \(AB=CD\), \(AD=CB\), and \(\angle B=70^\circ\). Find the measure of \(\angle D\) in degrees.
solution: Draw \(AC\). By SSS, \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle CDA\). The corresponding angles \(\angle B\) and \(\angle D\) are equal, so \(\angle D=70^\circ\).
